title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Salesforce & Anthropic Launch Salesforce in Claude Keynote: Salesforce introduces 37 pre-built sales skills directly in Claude, bringing accounts, opportunities, and pipeline forecasting into AI workflows, backed by a live Dreamforce keynote with Marc Benioff and Dario Amodei.

Nous Research Cleans 1M Lines of Code with 1,393 Hermes Subagents: Nous Research publishes technical details showing how 1,393 Hermes subagents ran over 19 hours to trim a 1M line Python codebase by 34.4%, saving nearly $2M in engineering hours.

Google DeepMind Unveils 'Dream-RSI' Strategy Framework: DeepMind researchers release Dream-RSI (Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds), demonstrating how coding agents can optimize their exploration strategies in replay simulators without retraining model weights.

Community Reviews Claude Opus 5.2 Subagent Capabilities: Hands-on evaluations highlight Opus 5.2's industry-leading intent recognition, token efficiency, and 10/10 subagent delegation skills, alongside ongoing speculation around OpenAI GPT-6 Luna and Sol tier rollouts.

items.title: @claudeai & @salesforce: Salesforce in Claude Beta Launches with 37 Sales Skills
items.body: Salesforce and Anthropic release Salesforce in Claude in beta, integrating live accounts, deals, and pipeline dashboards with 37 pre-built sales skills directly inside conversation workflows.

items.title: @NousResearch: 1,393 Hermes Subagents Clean 1M Lines of Python Code
items.body: Nous Research demonstrates large-scale subagent coordination: 1,393 Hermes subagents ran across 19 hours to refactor and reduce a 1,000,000-line codebase by 34.4%, saving nearly $2M in human dev hours.

items.title: @MaxForAI: Google DeepMind Releases Dream-RSI Strategy Improvement Paper
items.body: Google DeepMind's Dream-RSI paper shows agents modifying their exploration strategy rather than weights, creating replay simulators from execution history to achieve up to 2.43x GPU kernel search efficiency.

items.title: @Gegam245074: Hands-On Evaluation of Claude Opus 5.2's Subagent Delegation
items.body: Detailed benchmark analysis of Claude Opus 5.2 highlights its token efficiency, precise plugin call timing, zero-hallucination design code adherence, and superior multi-agent delegation.

items.title: @opencode: Union Alpha Stealth Model Released Free for Agentic Coding
items.body: OpenCode releases its Union Alpha stealth model free for one week, specifically optimized for agentic coding with image input support and strict zero-data-training privacy.

items.title: @trq212: Why Stateless MCPs Outpace CLIs for Model Integration
items.body: Architecture breakdown showing why Model Context Protocols (MCP) with deferred tools and query parameters are outperforming local CLIs for complex AI integrations.

items.title: @Huang_Sihao: Sihao Huang Joins Anthropic as Head of Frontier Compute Strategy
items.body: Sihao Huang announces he is joining Anthropic to lead frontier compute strategy and infrastructure expansion alongside Tom Brown.

items.title: @moomoo: Moomoo Integrates as Official X Cashtag Trading Partner
items.body: Fintech platform Moomoo officially partners with X, enabling one-click stock trading directly from inline X Cashtag mentions.

items.title: @shillman1: Fuel Price Disclosure Executive Order Sparks Market Debate
items.body: Policy analysts track new executive actions targeting energy price transparency and retail consumer cost metrics ahead of upcoming quarterly economic reports.

items.title: @elonmusk: Elon Musk Cites E.M. Forster Classic During Gaming Server Outage
items.body: Elon Musk draws parallels between E.M. Forster's classic sci-fi essay 'The Machine Stops' and launch-day login queue failures across major gaming titles.

items.title: @iMiaSanMia: FC Bayern Honors Joshua Kimmich for 500th Club Appearance
items.body: Bayern Munich celebrates German midfielder Joshua Kimmich with a commemorative presentation following his landmark 500th official match for the club.

items.title: @GUST_EN: Atelier Karia Announced for Next-Gen Consoles & PC
items.body: Koei Tecmo and Gust officially unveil Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories for PS5, Nintendo Switch 2, and Steam.
